title: 03 · Date range picker (Wayfern)
strengths: A price in every night and 'Best price' fern marks is a real idea taken from KAYAK and Kiwi and pushed further; the totals line '4 nights · €101 a night avg' is believable
Full state coverage: lower/typical/higher, best price, today, sold out, hover, focus, check-in, in range, check-out, past, plus error and loading
slop_signals: The palette is cream paper + tan cells + coral cells + terracotta band + warm brown-black ink: exactly the cream/orange/brown combination the house rules forbid; the 'typical' tan and 'higher' pink fills turn both months into a wall of beige and salmon
'Lower' cells are cream on a white card, so the key's first tier is nearly invisible while 'Typical' (the majority) is the loudest; the heat reads inverted
The sun and rolling-hills backdrop at the bottom is three overlapping gradient blobs in peach, tan and sand (decorative gradient shapes for no reason)
Every day number is weight 800, so 60 bold numbers compete with the range band that should own the screen
fixes: Cool the page: white card, neutral near-black ink; keep one terracotta for the band and button; give 'typical' no fill at all and mark only cheaper (pale green or the fern) and pricier (one warm tint), as KAYAK's three tiers do
Day numbers at 600 and prices at 400 in grey; let the band and the ink circles carry the weight
Remove the hills, or replace them with one flat sand shape with no gradient
Make the 'Lower' tier visibly lighter than the card (or outline it) so the legend is true

references.what: Three-tier whole-cell heat with a legend; the picked range is near-black so it never shares a colour with the heat
Price under each day in soft round tiles with a 'Cheaper / Average / Higher' key; tiers are green, yellow and pink, not three warm tones
Prices under days on plain white cells; cheap days are coloured by the price text only, so the grid stays calm
Two months with no fills, range ends as black circles and a light band; the most restrained version of this pattern

changed: Rebuilt as step 1 of Wayfern's booking flow at real size: a rate calendar in weeks (month gutter, stepped month rule) and a 'Your stay' receipt that lists every night
Cream/tan/coral/brown palette, gradient hills, bold day numbers and the states panel removed; white page, pure greys, ink logo, terracotta only for the stay and the request
One cheap signal: green price text for nights at least 10% under the computed usual price (median of open nights, EUR 87); ferns removed
Booking rules hold: Fri/Sat arrivals stay 2 nights, invalid leave days greyed, 'Leave only' mornings, a real race error (a night booked a minute ago)
Totals re-added (467, 547, 185); cancellation date computed from the arrival; en-GB dates
Engine: warmth 88 to 22, roundness 88 to 60, expression 70 to 45, Albert Sans, pure greys, brand #E4572E restored
Two earlier rebuilds in this round scored 3 (too close to Airbnb); fresh-eyes audit of this one 4/5, all remaining notes fixed

facts: mockups/05-components-board and mockups/08-made-with-opendesigner embed this shot.png; their captions may still describe the old warm price-heat picker; re-check and re-render them
The cabin thumbnail is a hotlinked Unsplash photo of a real lake (Laghi di Fusine) labelled with the invented Lake Vessa

mockups/05-components-board (and 08 where it uses this piece) crop this shot.png with fixed background-position offsets set for the old layout; the crops now land on different content and need new offsets

round4.pairwise: 2 of 3 better (Shopify -2, Mixpanel +2, Klaviyo +3); worst margin 2
changed: New concept and brand: Gridlark, a solar-portfolio monitoring tool; the date range picker open on its Generation dashboard (presets, two months, compare period, partial-data days)
Wayfern booking calendar, price heat, receipt panel and serif removed; Inter only, cobalt only for the chosen range and Apply
Dashboard numbers add up (4,812 vs 4,531 MWh, +6.2%; 5 of 14 sites with plausible capacity factors)
Audit fixes: legend wording, one active state, grid aligned to its column, picker moved right so the main KPI shows, compare dates in the footer, disabled next-month arrow
Engine: re-sketched as Gridlark (dense, calm, technical), base size 14, dials lowered; brand #2b5bd7 kept
Stale extra frames (shot-leave, shot-loading, shot-taken) deleted
Per PRESENTATION.md and the round-4 audit row: one range only (compare off), seven presets, no legend or data dots, no time fields, no field icons
Last 30 days (Sep 15 - Oct 14) so the range spans both months; ink selection and Apply, cobalt only in the logo; popover anchored to its trigger with its edge on a KPI boundary
Dashboard re-derived for 30 days (10,463 MWh, 20.2% capacity factor, late-September output above October's); lighter bars so the picker leads
